name: Agent Control Standard
description: Sends signed agent steps to an ACS Guardian and enforces its decisions.

hmacKeyId.description: The key_id the Guardian uses for this HMAC secret (§10).

hmacSecretFile.description: File containing the HMAC secret in standard base64. The decoded secret must hold at least 32 bytes.

hmacSecretEnv.description: Environment variable containing the HMAC secret in standard base64. The decoded secret must hold at least 32 bytes.

deadlineMs.description: Maximum time a hook waits for Guardian requests, including handshakes. The hook reserves its last 250 ms to record the answer. Must be shorter than hookTimeoutMs.

hookTimeoutMs.description: Timeout requested from OpenClaw for each hook. Must exceed deadlineMs so the plugin can answer first. On timeout, OpenClaw lets the original through for reply_dispatch, reply_payload_sending and message_sending.

pingIntervalMs.description: Interval between gateway system/ping probes (ACS §13). A failure logs as a warning; recovery logs once.

maxUndecidedMessages.description: Maximum messages kept per session for a run that is not yet admitted. The plugin drops a further message, since the Guardian never sees it.

maxAttachmentBytes.description: Maximum measured attachment bytes per inbound message. URL-only attachments do not count. The plugin drops a message over the limit, since the Guardian never sees it.
